implemented: A configurable per-name no-trade band suppresses small scheduled target changes and retains their value as explicit cash.
Material changes still use the optimizer's turnover cost and maximum one-way turnover cap.
The result exposes whether a scheduled evaluation actually triggered a rebalance.
The shared signal allocator forwards its band setting to the target optimizer.

tests.result: 11 passed; mypy, Ruff, and diff checks passed.

limitations: The 0.005 NAV default is a configurable engineering assumption, not a market-calibrated optimum.
No live costs, marks, or prospective rebalance outcomes were used.
